Research Profile

Chemical engineer and R&D scientist working where reaction engineering, multiphase flow, and carbon materials meet. My work centres on clean hydrogen from methane pyrolysis and floating‑catalyst CVD (FC‑CVD) synthesis of carbon nanotubes, backed by kinetic, CFD, and data‑driven process modeling.

I have carried this work from lab bench to pilot plant: radioactive particle tracking of circulating fluidized beds during my Ph.D. at IIT Guwahati, methane‑pyrolysis reactor scale‑up at Clean Hydrogen Technologies, and high‑temperature FC‑CVD reactor development at UC Santa Barbara. The common thread is linking reactor hydrodynamics and reaction kinetics to product quality, and turning that understanding into processes that scale.

02

Professional Experience

2024–2026

Postdoctoral Research Associate

University of California, Santa Barbara — Dept. of Chemical Engineering

Supervisors: Prof. Eric McFarland & Prof. Phillip Christopher

  • Designed, fabricated, and automated high‑temperature FC‑CVD reactor systems (>1200 °C) for continuous methane decomposition, producing hydrogen and carbon nanomaterials (CNTs, graphitic carbon nanofibers) with tunable morphology and crystallinity.
  • Established a mechanistic understanding of CNT formation by decoupling hydrodynamic and chemical effects through coupled experimental–CFD investigations — localizing axial gradients in active carbon species (C₂Hₓ), ferrocene decomposition and Fe nanoparticle nucleation zones, and catalyst–carbon interaction regions governing VLS/VSS dissolution–precipitation kinetics.
  • Built and validated reaction‑engineering and gray‑box/data‑driven process models against reactor performance data, supporting scale‑up and operating‑parameter optimization.
Feb 2023 – May 2024

R&D Engineer

Clean Hydrogen Technologies (India) Pvt. Ltd — Nashik
  • Designed and scaled methane pyrolysis reactors from lab to pilot scale, achieving >90% methane conversion with simultaneous production of graphitic carbon and carbon nanofibers as high‑value co‑products.
  • Improved hydrogen yield and carbon nanofiber quality through systematic Design‑of‑Experiments‑driven catalyst formulation and process‑parameter optimization, identifying key process–structure relationships.
  • Led day‑to‑day reactor operations and troubleshooting, ensuring stable long‑duration performance and process reliability at pilot scale.
  • Analyzed reactor and plant operating data using Python‑based regression and statistical methods to build process–structure correlations supporting kinetic/process model development for scale‑up decisions.
2016–2024

Doctoral Researcher

Indian Institute of Technology, Guwahati

Radioactive particle tracking (RPT) studies of solid‑phase flow in pilot‑ and lab‑scale circulating fluidized beds.
